explanation: Induction on the circuit: an entry of evalSim at a NAND is at most k * (entry bound of the left trapdoor) + (entry bound of the right one), since G^{-1} has entries at most 1 and the circuit value is a bit (Circuit.eval_bit). Then (R_phi dec(-y))_a is at most k * errBound, and ball (2^(Bb-1)-1) is inside the big box (ball_subset_bigBox).
